description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of the core.fsmonitor feature in Git. It sets up different environments, runs various performance tests related to file system monitoring, and manages mock integrations such as Watchman and built-in fsmonitor daemons.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if enabled via environment variable GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE, setting up logging directory and files.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting relevant environment variables.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates specified number of touch timestamp updates on files within a directory.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the core.fsmonitor hook, choosing the appropriate integration script depending on environment variables and available prerequisites.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests, optionally dropping OS caches between runs based on environment variable GIT_PERF_7519_DROP_CACHE.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Executes a suite of performance tests with different Git status and diff commands, measuring performance with various file states.
